layers.name: count
layers.note: Cards per rank and per suit: all my usable cards (mine and the board), mine, the board, each opponent's up cards, each draw slot

layers.name: step
layers.note: Thresholds on the counts (pairs, trips, four to a flush, my highest card) and on the situation (low stack-to-pot, a cheap price, the dice)

layers.name: piece
layers.note: Hand pieces: straights per window, pairs that use my cards, top pair and overpairs, Omaha's two-plus-three combinations, lows, the Chen formula's gaps, opponents' up-card pairs, draw-slot memberships

layers.name: made
layers.note: Made-hand categories, draws and board texture; each game's first-round strength as a percentile

layers.name: ladder
layers.note: At least a pair, at least two pair, … at least quads: a thermometer over the made-hand categories (any five cards, and Omaha's two plus three)

layers.name: adjust
layers.note: Adjustments inside a category (pair rank, top pair, high cards), draws by cards to come, penalties for dangerous boards and up cards

layers.name: share1
layers.note: Each game's estimate of its share of the pot against one opponent still in the hand, gated by the game being played; strong draws

layers.name: knots
layers.note: The high (or whole) and low shares against one opponent on a piecewise-linear basis; five-card draw's first-round percentile

layers.name: share
layers.note: The share of the pot against this many opponents after this much betting from them: E^k, with k = opponents + 0.6 × aggression, one table per bucket, and a table for each half of a split pot

layers.name: decide
layers.note: The decision rule: margins of the share over the price and over the betting thresholds, bluffs, and the first-round rules by position

layers.name: out
layers.note: Action logits: fold, check or call, raise half the pot, raise the pot, all in (the largest legal one is played); keep scores at the draw
